texts.zh: 大量年久失修的建筑结构覆盖在整颗星球的表面。想必这里一度人口数以亿计，但现在却空无一人。不论谁在这里生活过，他们都一定留下了发生事情的线索，但要找到这些线索需要对行星表面进行仔细检查。
texts.en: Massive, dilapidated structures cover the entire surface of this world. At one time, this city-planet must have been home to billions - but now it is empty. Whoever lived here must have left clues about what happened to them, but finding them will require a detailed examination of the surface.

texts.zh: 对废墟的搜索绝大多数毫无成效，好在尚有一些线索指出了我们要搜寻的正确方向：我们发现了一处似乎是某种行星级数据处理和存储中心的地方。如果我们可以找到一种获取其中档案的方法，将会对解读这颗行星神秘过往起到不可估量的巨大作用。
texts.en: After much fruitless sifting through the ruins, a number of clues directed our search towards remains of a kind of planetary data processing- and storage center. If we can find a way to gain access to whatever records remain, they will be invaluable for unraveling this planet's mysterious past.

texts.zh:
在找到数据中心的入口并打通穿越废墟的道路后，重新激活和接入计算机系统出人意料的容易。自修复电路和学习算法很快上线以恢复受限的功能并开始与我们的计算机进行通讯。

事情的原因很快变得明了，[From.Planet.GetName]曾一度是一个被称为“有机全典”的机械帝国的首都。因其致力的目的而得名，此帝国由机器人和义体人混合组成，曾试图获取星系中一切有机生命的样本，以便防止这些生命在未知的星系级灾难中灭绝。

从现存记录中，我们搜集到的信息表明这一目的在他们年代的其他星系势力中并不受欢迎，他们最终被多个势力的联合攻击打败和毁灭。

然而，在该帝国覆灭前，他们已经取样了许多种族，并投入了大量精力研发出一台可以在有需要时重新创造出这些种族的装置进行。这一装置，即有机全典本身，被保存在附近某处。
texts.en:
Once we found an entrance to the data center and forced passage through the wreckage, it was a surprisingly easy task to reactivate- and interface with the computer systems. Self-repairing circuits and learning algorithms quickly came online to restore limited functionality, and communicate with our own computers.

The cause for this burst of activity quickly became clear: [From.Planet.GetName] was once the capital of a machine empire known as "The Omnicodex." Named for their driving purpose, the Omni were a hybrid of robots and cyborgs who had attempted to assimilate samples of all biological life in the galaxy, in order to prevent their extinction in the face of unknown galactic calamity.

From the records which survive, we gather that this course of action was not popular amongst the other galactic powers of their era; the Omni were eventually defeated in a joint campaign conducted by several of these empires.

Before their downfall, the Omni managed to sample a great deal of races, and much work was put into developing a device capable of re-creating them if the need should ever arise. This device - The Omnicodex proper - is apparently stored somewhere nearby.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 我们已经找到了有机全典。这件独特的装置内含建造其的机械帝国曾取样的每个物种的基因序列，并可以以基本元素作为原料重新创造出他们。不幸的是，看起来此机械帝国在覆灭前并没有足够的时间来完善这台装置，所以我们无法选择在激活该装置时要创造哪一个被取样的种族。
texts.en: The Omnicodex has been unearthed. This unique device contains the genetic sequence of every race that the Omni were able to sample, and can re-create them using only basic elements as raw materials. Unfortunately, it seems the Omni did not have time to perfect it before meeting their annihilation, so there is no means of selecting which of the many sampled races would be created in any given activation of the device.

label.zh: 获得遗珍后：激活有机全典（可重复）
label.en: With the relic: activate the Omnicodex (repeatable)

texts.zh:
有机全典包含了曾经居住在全星系的数千种智慧物种的详细基因数据。我们的遗传学家可以利用这些数据在我们的殖民地上复活一种已灭绝的物种。

一旦我们选择了一个殖民地，遗传学家就会仔细研究有机全典，并挑选出适合其气候的物种。
texts.en:
The Omnicodex contains detailed genetic data on thousands of sapient species that once inhabited the galaxy. Our geneticists could use that data to revive an extinct species on one of our colonies.

Once we have selected a planet, the geneticists will go through the Omnicodex and pick a species suitable to its climate.

summary.text:
# 废弃星球 / Ruined World

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 Precursors · 来源 Sources：common/archaeological_site_types/02_ancient_relics_arc_sites.txt:8；events/ancient_relics_arcsite_events_1.txt:584；common/solar_system_initializers/ancient_relics_initializers.txt:642；common/relics/relics.txt:290 · DLC：《远古遗物》Ancient Relics · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

遗址权重未设（只由初始化器创建），由星系初始化器 relic_system_4 创建（common/solar_system_initializers/ancient_relics_initializers.txt:642）；全银河最多一处。

No weight; created by the system initializer relic_system_4 (common/solar_system_initializers/ancient_relics_initializers.txt:642); at most one per galaxy.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

覆盖整颗行星的废弃巨型城市曾是机器帝国“有机全典”（Omnicodex）的首都；他们的行星数据中心里保存着一台能由基本元素复原所有被采样种族的装置——“有机全典”。

1. 废弃星球：遍布全星球的破败建筑，需要详细地表调查（小型文物）
2. 废弃星球：线索指向行星数据处理中心（工程学与社会学研究）
3. 废弃星球：重新启动数据中心，得知这里是机器帝国“有机全典”的首都（小型文物）
4. 废弃星球：有机全典出土：获得遗珍“有机全典”与大型文物

A planet-wide fallen megalopolis was the capital of the machine empire "the Omnicodex"; its planetary data centre holds the device that can recreate every race the Omni sampled — the Omnicodex.

1. Ruined World: dilapidated structures across the entire planet (small artifact)
2. Ruined World: clues lead to a planetary data centre (engineering and society research)
3. Ruined World: the data centre reactivates; this was the capital of the machine empire Omnicodex (small artifact)
4. Ruined World: the Omnicodex unearthed: the relic r_omnicodex and a large artifact

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 有机全典 / Omnicodex：激活遗珍时（须有殖民地）：从最多五个随机殖民地中选一个，在其上复活一个随机的灭绝非机械物种（无法指定物种）；没有殖民地时只有“明白了” / activating the relic (needs colonies): choose one of up to five random colonies and revive a random extinct non-machine species there (the species cannot be chosen); with no colony only "Understood"

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特殊的文明差异。 / No empire-specific variants beyond the reward wording.
- 掷骰失败时使用通用事件池 all_random_events（见“考古遗址：发掘意外”）。 / Failed rolls use the generic pool all_random_events (see "Archaeological Sites: excavation incidents").
